emily: Quick idea from roadmap planning: introduce 'entry gates' for catalog onboards + a clear emergency-unpin playbook. We need launch criteria, prioritization signals, and who signs off on forced migrations.
raj: Love it. Can we list the minimal acceptance gates? My draft: security review (PSA), perf baseline (P95 < target), quality eval (held-out prompts pass thresholds), and infra fit (memory/latency within bucket).
dina: Add model provenance: license check + third-party benchmark comparators. We had a legal flag last quarter because a vendor model had a weird license clause.
charlie: For perf baseline, we need sample harness config. Proposed config: `seq_len=2048`, batch sizes [1,8,32] for throughput curves, and a synthetic load test for 10k requests to measure cache hit behavior.
sophia: On pinning: customers often ask for long pins. Suggest default pin TTLs by tier: Hosted trial: 30d, Standard partner: 90d, Strategic partner: 365d (legal ok). Renewal requires revalidation on quality and perf.
emily: Emergency unpin scenario: if upstream model is deprecated and causes >Y% failure or quality regression, ops can trigger Unpin with automated migration to fallback variant. Need an explicit signoff matrix: ops can unpin immediately for safety, but commercial-impacting migrations require CS + legal notify.
raj: How to detect regression? Nightly diff job comparing pinned outputs to baseline and to default latest model on a seed of customer prompts. Alert if semantic divergence > 8% or latency delta > 30%.
dina: We should define 'semantic divergence' metric. Proposal: use embedding cosine distance threshold + BLEURT on a validation corpus. Flag if both embedding drift >0.12 and BLEURT delta < -0.05.
charlie: Runtime ops: if we do fallback routing, we need `pin-mapping` table and per-request metadata `x-pin-origin` for auditing. Also need to limit concurrent pinned variants per node to avoid cache explosion.
charlie: quick CLI sketch:```
rctl catalog pin --model open-llama-13b --owner acme --ttl 90d --rollback-on-drift true
```
sophia: For prioritization when capacity is constrained: recommend scoring by (1) customer SLO risk, (2) revenue/strategic weight, (3) infra fit penalty (how expensive to serve), (4) migration friction (how many customers use this model). Normalize to 100 and rank.
emily: Do we allow auctions/bids? finance weighs in: auctions introduce inequality; maybe allow 'credits' as tie-breaker but not core.
billing-bot: FYI preliminary estimate: pinning-heavy models increase token-cost by ~9-15% due to higher sequence lengths and lower effective batching. (snapshot 3123460120)
raj: Launch checklist draft: 1) Acceptance gates implemented in onboarding UI, 2) Pin API + rollback endpoints (`POST /catalog/pins`, `POST /catalog/pins/{id}/unpin`, `GET /catalog/pins/{id}/audit`), 3) Nightly eval runner + alerts, 4) Console TTL + renewal UX, 5) Pilot with 3 customers across sizes.
dina: Pilot selection: one OSS-heavy customer, one mid-market with strict latency SLOS, one enterprise with legal/compliance needs. We'll simulate deprecation scenarios in staging.
emily: Operational runbook snippet: if alert fires, ops performs triage steps: 1) verify alert, 2) run canary migration to fallback, 3) notify CS/legal, 4) if rollback fails, escalate to incident channel. Need clear SLAs for each step.
charlie: Engineering asks: perf delta for fallback shim vs native, incremental storage for pinned artifacts, and max pinned variants per node. I'll prototype numbers in 5 business days.
sophia: Console UX: show pin status badges (Active, Expiring, Expired, EmergencyMigrated) + countdown and 1-click migrate. Also surface expected cost delta on migration.
emily: Action items: @charlie perf spike (5 days), @raj finalize scoring rubric + example weights (EoWeek), @dina assemble pilot candidate list (EoWeek), @sophia mock Console tile (next Wed). I'll capture and add to roadmap doc. React :eyes: with any concerns.
